thread:
hana: Heads up 1: Customer asks from AcmeHealth + BetaCorp: simple per-tenant cost breakdown, basic error analytics, and a small set of tracing hooks before GA. We need a minimal, deliverable surface.
omar: Agreed. Let's avoid full trace stitching. Propose scope: dashboard widgets + request-span tags + daily cost CSV export.
rachel: For dashboards: prebuilt "Tenant Overview" with requests/min, p50/p95, error %, and cost trend sparkline. Keep filters: tenant, model, route. No fancy drilldowns for GA.
devon: Tracing hooks: instrument LLM gateway to emit a span for each in-flight request with tags: tenant_id, model, route, token_count. Sampling default 5%. This is just for debugging, not full distributed traces.
hana: Error analytics: aggregate top-5 error codes/messages by tenant and route, with links to raw logs. Does our logs pipeline have tenant tags?
omar: Yes, request headers already include tenant_id; logs and billing ingestion both have that. Billing lag ~2hrs though, call that out in UX.
rachel: UI acceptance criteria proposal: 
- Tenant Overview dashboard present in template library
- Widgets load <1.2s for 30s lookback
- CSV export of daily per-tenant token counts and cost estimate
- Top-5 error reasons shown with link to logs
devon: Eng estimates: platform work ~2 dev-weeks (gateway hooks + sampling), frontend ~1.5 dev-weeks (widgets + CSV). Ops: add runbook entries, ~1 day.
hana: Prioritization: if only one item this sprint, which?
omar: Dashboards first 1: gives visibility to customers immediately.
devon: If oncall pain is extreme, tracing hooks win. But most customers demanded cost visibility.
rachel: Sales note: cost CSV is mentioned in two renewal conversations. I'd push cost export in sprint A with dashboards.
hana: Decision: sprint A = dashboards + cost CSV, sprint B = tracing hooks + runbook. Action owners: @rachel dashboard mocks by Fri, @omar infra ETA + PR plan, @devon gateway change and sampling defaults, @hana customer comms.
ops-bot: Created RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/observe-minimum-ga-surface :bookmark_tabs:
hana: GA gating: cost estimate within 7% of billing totals for daily aggregates, dashboard availability 99.5%, no greater than 1.5x median latency regression on 95% of routes when sampling enabled. I'll add these to the RFC.
omar: I'll add a note about billing lag in the UI copy and a tooltip.
rachel: I'll prep two short customer-ready lines and a FAQ blurb for renewals.
devon: I'll draft the runbook snippet for ops and a quickplay for triaging errors with sampled spans.
hana: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after mocks and infra ETA. :thumbsup:
